description:
Get official air quality for a German city (PM10, NO2 and more).

Sourced from the Umweltbundesamt (UBA). Read-only. For live nearest-station
hourly readings use ``get_city_resource(slug, resource='air')`` instead.

slug.description: City identifier, e.g. 'berlin' or 'hamburg'. Resolved leniently: the German name with or without umlauts, any casing, a common English exonym or short form also works (München/munich/munchen -> muenchen, cologne -> koeln, frankfurt -> frankfurt-am-main). An unknown name returns 404 with a 'Meintest du ...?' suggestion. list_cities gives the canonical slugs.

name: air_quality
title: Air Quality
